title: 🔴 The driver of the "death car" at Karaj's Golzar intersection has been executed.
text:
"🔴 The driver of the "death car" at Karaj's Golzar intersection has been executed."

"🔸During the American-Zionist coup attempt in January 2026 (Dey of last year), Shahram Sadeghi ran over several officers near Karaj's Golzar intersection after attacking them with his Pride vehicle."

"🔸 The intentional running-over of law enforcement officers—which shocked and astonished bystanders at the scene—resulted in injuries to 7 police officers, affecting their heads, legs, hands, and eyes."

"🔸 This extremely violent act by Sadeghi, which was accompanied by widespread support from hostile opposition media, also put one of the officers who was present at the scene to ensure public safety into a 3-month coma."

"🔸 Sadeghi, who fled the scene by setting his own car on fire after this brutal attack, was identified, arrested, put on trial, and was hanged at dawn today.
